# mistershell_license_status (Data Source)

Reads MisterShell license_status through the authenticated API. Permissions and scope are enforced by the server.

Requires MisterShell >= 2.1.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_license_status" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity.
- `projection` (Dynamic) Entitlement projection including available, unavailable_reason, core_feature, inherited, extras, capabilities, capacity, licensed_to, warning_level, licensing_email, warning_licenses, ha, instance_id, revision, reconciled_at and licenses. available=false means an unavailable snapshot, not Free entitlement.

## Entitlement and capacity projection

Requires `app.licenses.read`. This lookup returns the full administrative
projection, including billing identity and per-license summaries, but no signed
license keys. `projection.available = false` with `unavailable_reason` means the
snapshot is unavailable; do not interpret it as a Free license.

| Field | Values or shape |
|---|---|
| `core_feature`, `inherited` | `free`, `base`, `pro`, `enterprise`; `core_feature` can be null when unavailable |
| `extras` | List containing `ids`, `collector`, `proxy`, `canary` |
| `ha` | Object with `topology` (`single`, `multi`), `compliant`, and nullable `violation_reason` |
| `warning_level` | `none`, `approaching`, `imminent`, `expired` |
| `capacity` | Objects with `category`, `used`, `capacity`, `over_capacity` |
| `capacity.category` | `resources`, `sensors`, `collector_workers`, `proxies`, `canaries` |
| `capabilities` | Objects with `id`, `granted`, nullable `reason` and `capacity_category` |
| `capabilities.id` | `commands.author`, `ai.author`, `reports.operate`, `workers.remote`, `auth.enterprise`, `vault.external`, `log_forwarding.configure`, `ha.multicore`, `policy.session`, `policy.recording`, `policy.fact`, `policy.configuration`, `recording.create`, `automation.execute`, `configure.workflows`, `ids.operate`, `collector.operate`, `proxy.operate`, `canary.operate`, `resources.operate` |

Other fields are `licensed_to`, `licensing_email`, `warning_licenses`, `ha`,
`instance_id`, `revision`, `reconciled_at`, and `licenses`. Entitlement may lag an
accepted license mutation until reconciliation completes. Capacity usage is
live status; it is not a Terraform-managed limit.

## License metadata

Per-license summaries contain `license_id`, nullable `status`, `feature`, `quantity`, `email`,
`licensed_to`, `issued_at`, `expires_at`, `error`, and non-null `install_channel`
and `format_version`. Signed license strings are never returned by reads.

| Field | Values |
|---|---|
| `status` | `denied`, `invalid`, `expired`, `email_mismatch`, `core_license_missing`, `lower_tier_suppressed`, `active`, or null when validity is not available |
| `feature` | `base`, `pro`, `enterprise`, `ids`, `collector`, `proxy`, `canary`, or null for unreadable legacy material |

Requires `app.licenses.read`.
